import json
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

ledger_path = Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json')
ledger = json.loads(ledger_path.read_text())
last = ledger['quota_snapshots'][-1]
q = last['quota']
remaining = q['gpu_seconds_total'] - q['gpu_seconds_used'] - q['gpu_seconds_reserved']
completion = Path('results/training/kaggle_padding_retry_completion.json')
r = json.loads(completion.read_text())
first_generation = [s['cases'][0]['wall_seconds'] for s in r['stages'].values()]
assert remaining < min(first_generation)
assert json.loads(Path('results/training/kaggle_padding_retry.json').read_text())['status'] == 'outputs_retrieved'
record = {'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'close this weekly-budget submission loop because no useful cold-start run fits'}),
          'source':Path(__file__).read_text(), 'status':'closed_no_meaningful_run_fits',
          'official_snapshot':last,'account_quota_hours_used':q['gpu_seconds_used']/3600,
          'account_quota_hours_total':q['gpu_seconds_total']/3600,'remaining_seconds':remaining,
          'minimum_observed_first_generation_seconds_including_warmup':min(first_generation),
          'evidence_file':str(completion),'evidence_sha256':file_sha256(completion),
          'reason':'Remaining quota is below even the observed first native generation including warmup, before counting fresh environment/model loading. No further full cohort, training seed or useful diagnostic can be admitted with an evidence-based cold-start allowance.',
          'scope':'Official weekly account quota, not a fabricated attribution of all usage to this task or a sum of physical GPU-card compute hours. Per-kernel script wall times and unknown allocation boundaries remain separately recorded.',
          'newest_family_status':'Qwen3.8-27B chosen after measured two-T4 fit. Full registered run has 500 downloaded SFT updates; later progress/final outputs remain unverified after computer-use transport outage.',
          'continued_work':'Finish the registered local MLX validation, DAgger/RLOO loop, NIM cohorts, frozen evaluation and final reporting. Do not automatically consume the next weekly GPU allocation.'}
Path('results/training/kaggle_budget_closure.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
ledger['submission_loop_closed'] = {'result_file':'results/training/kaggle_budget_closure.json','status':record['status'],
                                    'account_quota_hours_used':record['account_quota_hours_used'],'remaining_seconds':remaining}
ledger_path.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ('status','account_quota_hours_used','remaining_seconds')}))
